title: [Ginsenoside Rg1 modulates BV2 microglial activation and neuroinflammation via the JAK2/STAT3 pathway].
authors: Wu, Yuke; Duan, Zhaoda; Xu, Dongyao; Yang, Yujia; Peng, Yingqi; Wu, Chunyun; Yang, Li
journal: Xi bao yu fen zi mian yi xue za zhi = Chinese journal of cellular and molecular immunology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参皂苷Rg1通过JAK2/STAT3通路调节小胶质细胞神经炎症，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Objective To investigate how ginsenoside Rg1 regulates microglia-mediated neuroinflammation through the JAK2/STAT3 pathway following ischemic stroke. Methods Potential Rg1 targets were identified by network pharmacology, and molecular docking was used to evaluate ligand-target interactions. BV2 microglia were cultured and divided into four groups: Control, OGD, OGD+Rg1, and OGD+Rg1+AG490 (co-treatment with the JAK2 inhibitor AG490). Western blot and dual immunofluorescence staining were used to assess the expression of phosphorylated JAK2 (p-JAK2), phosphorylated STAT3 (p-STAT3), and downstream inflammatory mediators inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) and tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha). Results Network pharmacology revealed 16 overlapping targets between Rg1 and ischemic stroke, with STAT3 identified as a key node in the JAK2/STAT3 pathway. Molecular docking showed strong binding affinity between Rg1 and core targets. Rg1 treatment significantly reduced the expression of p-JAK2, p-STAT3, iNOS, and TNF-alpha compared with the OGD group. The AG490 co-treatment group exhibited similar inhibitory effects, with no significant difference from Rg1 alone. Conclusion Ginsenoside Rg1 suppresses the expression of iNOS and TNF-alpha in activated BV2 microglia, likely by inhibiting phosphorylation of the JAK2/STAT3 pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的 探讨人参皂苷Rg1在缺血性卒中后通过JAK2/STAT3通路调控小胶质细胞介导的神经炎症的作用。方法 通过网络药理学鉴定Rg1的潜在靶点，并利用分子对接评估配体-靶点相互作用。培养BV2小胶质细胞，分为四组：对照组、OGD组、OGD+Rg1组和OGD+Rg1+AG490组（与JAK2抑制剂AG490联合处理）。采用Western blot和双重免疫荧光染色评估磷酸化JAK2（p-JAK2）、磷酸化STAT3（p-STAT3）及下游炎症介质诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）和肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-alpha）的表达。结果 网络药理学揭示Rg1与缺血性卒中之间有16个重叠靶点，其中STAT3被确定为JAK2/STAT3通路的关键节点。分子对接显示Rg1与核心靶点之间具有强结合亲和力。与OGD组相比，Rg1处理显著降低了p-JAK2、p-STAT3、iNOS和TNF-alpha的表达。AG490联合处理组表现出类似的抑制效果，与单独使用Rg1相比无显著差异。结论 人参皂苷Rg1抑制活化BV2小胶质细胞中iNOS和TNF-alpha的表达，可能通过抑制JAK2/STAT3通路的磷酸化实现。
